$comment: One source of truth for how every hook is wired.
install.sh merges this into settings.json, doctor.sh checks the live
settings against it, tests/negative-control.py iterates it, and
settings.example.json is generated from it. They drifted apart once when
each held its own copy of the list, and the symptom was a hook that was
on disk, documented, and registered nowhere.
block: how the hook refuses. exit2 = non-zero exit. json = a decision
object on stdout. none = it never refuses, it only reports or injects.
A hook with block:none is a reporter and is judged on what it prints.

hooks.refuses: a high-blast-radius command with no rollback stated: launchd, cron, force-push, destructive DDL
the fourth look at a question already answered three times this session
a raw curl where a routed lane already exists
a grep PCRE flag that silently degrades to a clean-looking empty result
a state-changing command whose exit code is thrown away by a pipe
a unicode dash written into an authored file
a blind write over a path that already holds finished work
nothing: it warns when upstream has moved the same file underneath you
an expensive fan-out on work a cheaper lane already covers
an agent dispatch once the daily or weekly count is spent
a metered API call when a free lane answers the same question
nothing: it names the cheaper route for this subject before the call goes out
nothing: it records the result so the next identical search is free
nothing: it proves the guards are armed and flags any hook it does not know
nothing: it stamps which session this is, so the others can tell you apart
nothing: it names who else is live in this tree before you rewrite history
nothing: it re-injects what the last session left behind
nothing: it splits the prompt into items and re-injects them next turn, so part two cannot vanish
nothing: it re-injects work interrupted mid-flight, because a new prompt adds to the queue
nothing: it states the report contract before the reply is written rather than after
nothing: it demands a live check before any claim about what a system currently is
nothing: it puts the running cost in front of the model before it decides to fan out
ending the turn with work left on the floor: a dirty tree, an unpushed branch, an unanswered item
a report that answers something other than the question that was asked
nothing: it writes down what this session was doing, for the next one
